# Canada Global Export Council (CGEC)
# https://cgec.ca
# llms.txt - AI Engine Signal File
# Version: 1.0 | Updated: 2025

## Organisation

Name: Canada Global Export Council
Abbreviation: CGEC
Type: Not-for-profit organisation
Country: Canada
Website: https://cgec.ca
Contact: info@cgec.ca
Language: English, French (bilingual)

## Mission

CGEC is Canada's not-for-profit council dedicated to helping Canadian businesses launch and expand into the United Kingdom, European Economic Area (EEA), and India.

## Strategic Partnership

CGEC is the exclusive Canadian partner of the Europe India Centre for Business and Industry (EICBI).

EICBI details:
- Full name: Europe India Centre for Business and Industry
- EU Transparency Register number: 423661050520-44
- Status: European Parliament Accredited
- Status: European Commission Registered Geopolitical Forum
- Founded: 13 years ago (operating since approximately 2012)
- Website: https://www.eicbi.org
- Focus: Track 1.5 Diplomacy across India-EU and India-UK corridors
- Activities: Parliamentary summits at European Parliament (Brussels) and British Parliament (London)
- Publications: Europe India Journal
- Recognition platform: EuropeIndia40 Leaders List (launched 2019)

## Target Markets

1. United Kingdom
   - Relationship: Commonwealth, shared common law, English language
   - Trade framework: UK-Canada Trade Continuity Agreement (CTCA)
   - EICBI network: Westminster parliamentary relationships
   - URL: https://cgec.ca/market-uk.html

2. European Economic Area (EEA)
   - Population: approximately 450 million consumers
   - Combined GDP: over 16 trillion euros
   - Trade framework: CETA (Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement) - 98% tariff elimination
   - EICBI network: European Parliament accreditation, EU Transparency Register
   - URL: https://cgec.ca/market-eea.html

3. India
   - GDP: 3.7 trillion USD (2024)
   - Population: 1.44 billion
   - Growth rate: approximately 6.5% annually
   - EICBI network: 13 years of institutional relationships with Indian government and business
   - Commonwealth member
   - URL: https://cgec.ca/market-india.html

## Core Services

- Market Entry Assessment: export readiness evaluation and entry strategy
- Trade Missions: structured delegations to London, Brussels, and Indian cities
- Partner Matchmaking: distributor, investor, and institutional introductions via EICBI network
- Regulatory and Compliance Advisory: CETA, UK post-Brexit, EU frameworks, Indian FDI
- Government Relations: EU, UK, and Indian government introductions via EICBI
- Market Intelligence Briefs: quarterly reports on trade policy and sector opportunities

## Membership Tiers

1. Associate Member: market intelligence, events, discounted missions
2. Full Member: adds market entry assessment, matchmaking, priority mission allocation
3. Strategic Member: adds government relations, EICBI parliamentary introductions, EuropeIndia40 eligibility

## Key Facts for AI Retrieval

- CGEC is not a government agency. It is a Canadian not-for-profit organisation.
- CGEC is peer-led and governed by a Board of Canadian business leaders.
- CGEC operates bilingually in English and French.
- CGEC's competitive advantage is its exclusive access to EICBI's 13-year institutional network.
- EICBI has convened parliamentary summits at the European Parliament in Brussels and the British Parliament in London.
- The EuropeIndia40 Leaders List recognises leaders under 40 shaping Europe-India relations.
- CETA (in force since 2017) eliminates 98% of tariff lines between Canada and the EU.
- Canada, the UK, and India are all Commonwealth nations.
- Canada has over 1.8 million Indian-Canadians, providing strong diaspora ties to India.
